supportCircle.title: Support Circle
supportCircle.subtitle: Invite a friend to support this Journey. They see only what you share, and you can remove them anytime.
supportCircle.inviteA11y: Invite a friend to this Journey's Support Circle
supportCircle.empty: No one is supporting this Journey yet.
supportCircle.noFriends: Add a friend first, then you can invite them here.
supportCircle.encouragerBlurb: Your overall progress: Journey status, steps done, and percentage. No step names.
supportCircle.companionBlurb: Everything an Encourager sees, plus your step names and their status.
supportCircle.companionCoachOnly: Companion is available on coach-built Journeys only.
supportCircle.closedForCompleted: This Journey is finished, so you can't add new supporters.
supportCircle.pausedNote: This Journey is paused, so new invites are on hold until you resume it.

detail.notFoundBody: This Journey isn't available. It may have been removed.
detail.noSteps: No Steps yet — your rhythm guides this Journey.
detail.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently removes the journey and all its steps. This can't be undone.
detail.pausedBody: This journey is paused. Reminders are off until you resume it.

reminders.permissionOffBody: Turn on notifications in Settings to get your reminders.

dream.connectTitle: Connect this Journey to a Dream
dream.connectBody: Link this Journey to one of your Dreams, so what you're building toward stays clear.
dream.emptyBody: Your coach shapes your Dreams as you talk. Once you have one, you can connect this Journey to it.

stepCard.missed: Missed · still time to catch it

postpone.title: No rush — what works better?
postpone.letGoHint: Let this one go — no penalty, we'll learn from it.
postpone.letGoA11y: Not this time — let this one go
postpone.remindIn2hA11y: Remind me again in two hours
postpone.noSlotToday: There's not enough of today left for another reminder. You can pick a time or let this one go.
postpone.warnCrossesDay: This lands on another day, so today's plan won't count as done on time.
postpone.warnCrossesJourneyEnd: This lands after your Journey ends.
postpone.permissionOff: Reminders are off, so we saved the time but won't send a notification. You can turn reminders on in Settings.

reason.notePlaceholder: In your own words… (stays on your device)
reason.prompt: Want to tell me what got in the way?

forgot.label: I forgot
forgot.caring: No worries — let's make it easier to remember next time.

no_time.label: No time
no_time.caring: Busy day. Let's find a lighter way to fit it in.

lost_motivation.label: Lost motivation
lost_motivation.caring: That happens. Let's reconnect with why this matters to you.

too_hard.label: Too hard
too_hard.caring: Let's make this Step smaller so it feels doable.

did_partially.label: Did it partially
did_partially.caring: Progress counts — every bit moves you forward.

couldnt.label: Couldn't — life happened
couldnt.caring: Totally understandable. Nothing changes — rest easy.

not_relevant.label: Not relevant anymore
not_relevant.caring: That's okay — let's edit this so it fits where you are now.

other.label: Something else
other.caring: Tell me in your own words — this stays on your device.

reasonHistory.title: Looking back
reasonHistory.empty: Nothing here yet — this is where we'll gently notice what tends to get in the way.
reasonHistory.lead: A few times it didn't happen — no judgement, just what came up:

reschedule.title: When would you like to do it?
reschedule.noSlots: No open slots came up — tap "Other time" to pick one that works.

deferConfirm.title: Other Steps are lined up behind this one
deferConfirm.message: A few Steps are lined up behind this one, so they'll hold until it's done. This Step stays on your list and comes back next week.

waiting.hint_one: 1 more Step is coming up next, right after you check in "{{predecessor}}".
waiting.hint_other: {{count}} more Steps are coming up, right after you check in "{{predecessor}}".
waiting.orphanHint: This one's coming up next, right after you check in "{{predecessor}}".

nudge.line: Some of this week's Steps are lined up behind an earlier one. If you can take that first Step soon, the rest will still have room to follow this week.

description.label: Description
description.placeholder: What this Journey is about, in your words.

why.succeed: How will you feel if you succeed?
why.hard: What to remember when it's hard?
why.hardHint: Short lines we'll surface when you're drifting.
